digest.component_or_area: ticket store rewrite and reclaim window
propositions: Execute a one-time destructive reclaim of the tickets branch via atomic force-with-lease after all writers (sessions, MCP servers, workflows) are confirmed quiescent and deployment of A6-0a/A6-0b is validated.
Converge the local tracker and 48 sibling worktrees (symlinked to one store) and the review-bot persistent clone via git fetch/reset before and after the rewrite.

Verify the rewritten commit graph is structurally identical (same commit/merge counts, tree hash, event-uuid/verdict/grandfathered data) and non-resurrecting (old tip not ancestor, <1 MiB growth, <150 MiB total size).

Land the mapped identity.enforce_since re-pin value through Gerrit with normal review-bot and administrator voting, using the Gerrit change's first post-window LLM-Review +1 as the deterministic resumption signal.
Restore GitHub workflows, AWS timers, LaunchAgents, and rebar runtime after publication, then validate reconciliation run success, state convergence, and final fsck cleanliness.
